MAR.note: The document covers a personal data law revision that addresses AI processing; it names no rule, authority or enforcement on a harm from AI.
No government body's use of AI is stated.
No AI tool in a public sector system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: Hespress reports that Law No. 09.08 on the processing of personal data, adopted in 2009, has remained largely unchanged, and that a draft bill amending it (prepared by the CNDP with the Ministry of Justice, covering AI, blockchain and precision medicine) has reached the General Secretariat of the Government.

systems.system: Law No. 09.08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data
National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
